attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "This fixes a mutation bug where combining PlacementInfo/AlternatesCollection previously mutated the shared 'first' instance (which may be a cached/shared object) causing incorrect placement bleed across shapes; the fix avoids mutation by returning a new combined object, which is a safe, well-contained behavioral correction but touches core shape placement logic used across all themes/modules."}

reason: This fixes a mutation bug where combining PlacementInfo/AlternatesCollection previously mutated the shared 'first' instance (which may be a cached/shared object) causing incorrect placement bleed across shapes; the fix avoids mutation by returning a new combined object, which is a safe, well-contained behavioral correction but touches core shape placement logic used across all themes/modules.
